_comment: Command-name sets for the bash guard. Single source of truth consumed by the shared core (~/.agents/guardrails/core.ts), used by Claude, Codex, pi, and opencode via their adapters. Data only — the logic lives in core.ts. See README.md. Add a dangerous command here once; all agents pick it up.
_find_policy: per-agent find handling (gate severity is 'ask'; each adapter maps that to a prompt or a block): 'always' = gate any find; 'exec' = gate only when an -exec/-delete primary is present; 'off' = ignore.
